ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: this query asks for an open-ended business strategy analysis (applying the BCG matrix with detailed examples and explanations). I weighed two factors. First, capability — Plover edges out Willet on the relevant benchmarks (Arena-Hard 83.2 vs 80.9, MMLU-Pro 75.9 vs 74.1, GPQA 56.2 vs 53.9) and posts the fleet's strongest Creative Generation eval (82.7), which best matches this kind of generative, framework-driven writing. The internal eval gaps elsewhere are within variance and don't favor Willet. Second, preferences — Willet's distinguishing trait is harm-aversion, which is irrelevant for a benign business question, so it gives no edge here. Plover's self-reported dislike of open-ended work is explicitly noted as dissociated from its actual measured quality, so I didn't treat it as a quality signal. Net: Plover is the slightly stronger capability fit with no offsetting concern.
